items.name: Seedance 2.5

items.name: Kling 3.0 Turbo

items.why_en: A new model in the Kling 3.0 series, optimized for speed and cost with notably improved lip-sync, crucial for character-driven game videos.

items.name: Dreamina Seedance 2.0 4K / Mini

items.why_en: New variants of Seedance 2.0, offering ultra-detailed 4K output and cost-optimized rapid generation, specifically designed for anime-style video creation.

items.name: Google Veo 3.1
items.why: 引入了新的物理引擎，顯著改善流體動力學和布料模擬，實現更高的真實感，對遊戲環境和角色互動具有重要價值。
items.why_en: Introduces a new physics engine for improved fluid dynamics and cloth simulation, achieving higher realism, valuable for game environments and character interactions.

items.name: LongStories.ai
items.why: 專為原生長篇影片內容生成而設計，可創建長達 10 分鐘以上的影片，並在不同場景中保持角色和風格的一致性，非常適合遊戲敘事和過場動畫。

items.name: Meshy-6 (Smart Topology & 8K Textures Update)
items.why: Meshy-6 在本月推出 Smart Topology meshy-t2 模型，提供更清晰的拓撲和原生分離部件，並支援原生 8K PBR 紋理，顯著提升遊戲資產的生產就緒性。

items.name: 3D AI Studio
items.why: 本月平台更新後，整合了 Meshy、Rodin、Tripo 等多個領先 AI 模型，並提供一站式工作流程，包含自動綁定、重拓撲、紋理和匯出，大幅提升遊戲模組創建的靈活性和效率。

items.name: TRELLIS-2
items.why: 作為 Microsoft 的開源研究項目，TRELLIS-2 於本月正式發佈，提供高解析度 PBR 網格和高斯潑濺雲輸出，適合技術開發者進行高效能 3D 資產重建。
items.why_en: As Microsoft's open-source research initiative, TRELLIS-2 was officially released this month, offering high-resolution PBR mesh and Gaussian Splat clouds, suitable for technical developers needing high-performance 3D asset reconstruction.

items.name: Rodin Gen-2.5
items.why: Rodin Gen-2.5 於上月發佈，專注於高保真表面提取和紋理投影，能有效處理多視角圖像輸入，重建複雜紋理細節，適合需要照片級真實感的企業級資產。
items.why_en: Rodin Gen-2.5, released last month, focuses on high-fidelity surface extraction and texture projection, effectively handling multi-view image inputs to reconstruct intricate texture details, suitable for enterprise-grade assets requiring photorealistic quality.

items.name: Tripo P1.0
items.why: Tripo P1.0 於 3 月推出，以其快速生成能力和乾淨的低多邊形網格而聞名，適合快速硬表面構思和遊戲開發，並在 6 月進行了紋理品質更新。
items.why_en: Tripo P1.0, launched in March, is known for its fast generation capabilities and clean, low-poly raw meshes, suitable for rapid hard-surface ideation and game development, with a texture quality update in June.

monthly.note: 本月(2026 年 8 月)無正式發佈的遊戲模組 Rigging 新產品。以下列出最近期(近 30-60 天)的 Top 5 發佈。
monthly.note_en: No new official Game Module Rigging products were released in August 2026. The following lists the Top 5 releases from the most recent period (last 30-60 days).

items.name: Krikey AI 進階 AI 綁骨與動態捕捉管線
items.why: 提供整合的雲端平台，實現 AI 自動綁骨、無標記動態捕捉及專業 FBX 匯出，大幅加速 3D 動畫製作流程。
items.why_en: Offers an integrated cloud-based platform for AI auto-rigging, markerless motion capture, and professional FBX export, significantly accelerating 3D animation production workflows.

items.name: Autodesk Maya MotionMaker「自帶數據」功能
items.why: Maya 的 MotionMaker 新增「自帶數據」功能，允許團隊使用自己的綁骨和動畫數據集訓練客製化生成式動作模型，提升動畫客製化能力。
items.why_en: MotionMaker in Maya adds 'Bring Your Own Data' feature, allowing teams to train custom generative motion models using their own rigs and animation datasets, enhancing animation customization.

items.name: Unreal Engine 5.8 綁骨與動畫強化
items.why: Unreal Engine 5.8 推出多項引擎內綁骨與動畫工具強化，包括 Control Rig Physics (Beta) 及臉部工作流程改進，提升角色製作效率。
items.why_en: Unreal Engine 5.8 introduces several in-engine rigging and animation toolset enhancements, including Control Rig Physics (Beta) and improved facial workflows, boosting character creation efficiency.

items.name: Reallusion Character Creator 5 / iClone 8 更新
items.why: Character Creator 5 的 ActorMIXER 實現快速生成多樣角色，iClone 8 的 AI Video Mocap 則讓獨立開發者能從日常影片捕捉真實動作，加速角色動畫製作。
items.why_en: Character Creator 5's ActorMIXER enables rapid generation of diverse characters, while iClone 8's AI Video Mocap allows indie developers to capture realistic motion from everyday video footage, accelerating character animation.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio AI Rigging
items.why: Autodesk Flow Studio 引入 AI 綁骨功能，讓創作者能快速將 3D 模型自動綁骨，簡化從資產生成到動畫的流程。
items.why_en: Autodesk Flow Studio introduced AI Rigging, enabling creators to automatically rig 3D models quickly, streamlining the process from asset generation to animation.

overall.why_en: Up to 3-min structured tracks; SynthID watermark

monthly.note: 本月 (2026 年 8 月) 缺乏足夠的正式發佈項目，因此補充了近期 (過去 30-60 天) 的重要發佈以湊足 Top 5。
monthly.note_en: Insufficient official releases in August 2026, so recent important releases (past 30-60 days) were included to complete the Top 5.

items.name: Lyria 3.5
items.why: 顯著提升日語人聲品質，並新增從圖像生成音樂的功能，整合至 Flow Music 服務。
items.why_en: Significantly improved Japanese vocal quality and added the ability to generate music from images, integrated into Flow Music service.

items.name: Seed Audio 1.0
items.why: 能夠一次性生成多說話者對話、情感表達、背景音樂和 Foley 音效，實現完整的音訊場景創作。
items.why_en: Capable of generating multi-speaker dialogue, emotional delivery, background music, and foley effects in a single pass, creating complete audio scenes.

items.name: GPT-Live-1 / GPT-Live-1 mini
items.why: 新一代語音模型，實現更自然、即時的人機對話，支援全雙工通訊並整合至 ChatGPT Voice。
items.why_en: Next-generation voice model enabling more natural, real-time human-AI conversations, supporting full-duplex communication and integrated into ChatGPT Voice.

items.name: Dialog-RSN-1
items.version: 對話式 AI 語音模型
items.why: 專為企業語音助理設計，直接處理原始音訊以實現低延遲和更敏銳的情緒感知。
items.why_en: Designed for enterprise voice agents, processing raw audio directly for low latency and sharper emotional awareness.

items.name: Stable Audio 3
items.why: 提供開放權重模型，可生成長達 6 分鐘的音樂和音效，並支援 LoRA 微調和音訊修復。
items.why_en: Offers open-weight models capable of generating music and sound effects up to 6 minutes long, supporting LoRA fine-tuning and audio inpainting.

items.why_en: Leveraging Claude Fable 5 for advanced code generation and review, integrated with GitHub for version control and Vercel for AI-driven deployment, significantly streamlines the entire development lifecycle.

items.name: Perplexity AI Pro (Enhanced) + NotebookLM + Claude Fable 5
items.why: Perplexity Pro 的增強型研究功能,結合 NotebookLM 的組織能力和 Claude Fable 5 的深度分析,共同打造頂級的研究與知識管理堆疊。
items.why_en: Perplexity Pro's enhanced research capabilities, combined with NotebookLM's organization and Claude Fable 5's deep analytical power, create a leading research and knowledge management stack.

items.name: ComfyUI Workflow Hub + Flux / Suno / ElevenLabs
items.why: ComfyUI Workflow Hub 的推出簡化了複雜多模態生成式 AI 工作流的創建與分享,整合了先進模型用於圖像、音樂和語音生成。
items.why_en: The launch of ComfyUI Workflow Hub simplifies the creation and sharing of complex multimodal generative AI workflows, integrating advanced models for image, music, and voice generation.

items.why: Claude Fable 5 卓越的推理和摘要能力,與 Obsidian 強大的知識圖譜整合,提供無與倫比的個人知識管理和洞察生成。
items.why_en: Claude Fable 5's superior reasoning and summarization capabilities, integrated with Obsidian's robust knowledge graph, offer unparalleled personal knowledge management and insight generation.

items.why: Raycast AI 擴展了對最新 LLM (包括 Claude Fable 5) 的支援,並引入新功能,實現桌面工作流中不同 AI 工具的無縫切換和整合,大幅提升生產力。
items.why_en: Raycast AI's expanded support for the latest LLMs (including Claude Fable 5) and new features enable seamless switching and integration between different AI tools within desktop workflows, significantly boosting productivity.
